name: Receipt scanner
summary: A web app where freelancers and small accounting firms upload receipts and invoices; a worker reads the fields and files them for the monthly VAT return.

business.customers: Freelancers and accounting firms with up to 20 staff, on a monthly plan.
critical_flows: Upload a receipt and see it read within a minute

environments.name: prod
environments.purpose: The only environment: releases are tested on production behind a feature flag.

users.definition: Accounts that uploaded or exported at least once in 30 days.
